title: The dualizing functor is an anti-autoequivalence of the bounded coherent category with square the identity
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a dualizing complex the functor given by the internal hom into it is an anti-equivalence of the bounded coherent derived category, exchanges the bounded-above and bounded-below coherent subcategories and squares to the identity (author lemma at source lines 2817-2829, label lemma-dualizing). The proof (source lines 2831-2845) checks the functor lands in the bounded coherent category and produces a canonical isomorphism from an object to its double dual through the evaluation isomorphism, which makes the functor its own quasi-inverse (proof lines 2831-2844). The comparison map is the substance. H3.
